_description: Authors of the layouts of the analysis library, shown with each layout. The registry layouts take theirs from static/layouts/registry/<id>/meta.toml. « basis » says where a credit comes from: « source » when the author's own page, file or repository states it (« checked » is the date it was read, « evidence » what it says), « knowledge » when it is the generally known author no page has confirmed yet (to verify by the maintainer). A layout without an entry is credited to the collection it was taken from.

qwerty.evidence: US patent 207,559 (C. L. Sholes, 1878) is Sholes's; its text names no letter order, and the drawings were not read.

colemak.evidence: Colemak FAQ: « It's after the name of its creator, Shai Coleman. », released on 1 January 2006.

workman.evidence: Workman site: « By OJ Bucao, September 6, 2010 ».

norman.evidence: Norman site: « David Norman has waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights to Norman keyboard layout »; it states no year of creation (only its addition to xkeyboard-config in 2013).

halmak.evidence: Halmak repository (github.com/MadRabbit/halmak serves it): « Copyright (C) 2016 Nikolay Nemshilov ».

mtgap30.evidence: Michael Dickens's blog, The Keyboard Layout Project: « I'm calling it MTGAP. »; the page names no version 3.0.

qgmlwy.evidence: Carpalx, « full optimization » (read through the Internet Archive, 2015; the live host refuses automated reads): « © 2005-2014 Martin Krzywinski », « the resulting layout is QGMLWY ».

engram.evidence: Engram repository: « created by Arno Klein »; Engram v1.2 dated 2021-02-08.

semimak_jq.evidence: semi's genkey repository holds « Semimak JQ » with these keys; semilin.dev: « you might know me as the 'semi' in 'semimak.' ».

hands_down.evidence: Hands Down site: « … are trademarks of R. Alan Reiser »; its menu names Hands Down Neu and Hands Down Reference.

hands_down_neu.evidence: Hands Down site: « … are trademarks of R. Alan Reiser »; its menu names Hands Down Neu and Hands Down Reference.

hands_down_reference.evidence: Hands Down site: « … are trademarks of R. Alan Reiser »; its menu names Hands Down Neu and Hands Down Reference.

capewell.evidence: Michael Capewell's site, « Projects / Alternative Keyboard Layouts »: « The Capewell-Dvorak Layout », « The Capewell Layout ».

capewell_dvorak.evidence: Michael Capewell's site, « Projects / Alternative Keyboard Layouts »: « The Capewell-Dvorak Layout », « The Capewell Layout ».

arensito.evidence: Håkon Hallingstad's home page, « The Arensito Keyboard Layout » (read through the Internet Archive, 2010; the live page answers 502): « I have been using the arensito letter layout since 1. of January 2001 ».

sturdy.evidence: Oxey's layouts repository, sturdy/index.html: « Sturdy is my attempt at making a layout that has very high rolls … ».

adnw.evidence: adnw.de, « Bewertungsverfahren »: AdNW was made with the keyboard optimizer whose « Entwickler Andreas Wettstein » it quotes; KLA's AdNW file names him as its author.

bone.evidence: neo-layout.org, Bone: « Bone wurde von „effchen“ und „danros“ im IRC mit Hilfe von Arnes Optimierer … » (made with Arne's optimizer).

koy.evidence: neo-layout.org/Layouts names KOY « Weiterentwicklung von AdNW » without an author; adnw.de has no page that names one.
